```{r setup}
#| include=FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(flextable)

if (interactive()) {
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path
  )$params
}

dashboard <- read_csv(here("data", "dashboard_essa.csv"))

```

## Solano ESSA 2025

```{r current_essa}
#| echo = FALSE

assistance_var <- paste0("essa_status", params$year)

essa_current <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(reportingyear == params$year) |>
  drop_na(essa_status) |>
  distinct(districtname, schoolname, essa_status) |>
  count(districtname, essa_status) |>
  arrange(districtname, essa_status)

essa_current |>
  flextable() |>
  merge_v(part = "body", j = 1) |>
  set_header_labels(
    districtname = "District Name",
    essa_status = "ESSA Status",
    n = "Number of Schools"
  ) |>
  theme_vanilla()

```

## ESSA Schools Over Time
```{r essa_over_time}
#| echo = FALSE

essa_over_time <-
  dashboard |>
  drop_na(essa_status) |>
  distinct(reportingyear, districtname, schoolname, essa_status) |>
  count(reportingyear, districtname, essa_status) |>
  arrange(districtname, reportingyear, essa_status)

essa_over_time |>
  filter(essa_status != "No Status") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reportingyear, y = n, color = essa_status)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~districtname) +
  labs(
    title = "ESSA Schools Over Time by District",
    x = "Reporting Year",
    y = "Number of Schools",
    color = "ESSA Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## ATSI Groups `r params$year`
```{r atsi_groups}
#| echo = FALSE

atsi_essa <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(reportingyear == params$year, atsi_support == 1) |>
  drop_na(essa_status) |>
  distinct(districtname, student_group_long) |>
  arrange(districtname, student_group_long)

atsi_essa |>
  flextable() |>
  merge_v(part = "body", j = c(1)) |>
  set_header_labels(
    districtname = "District Name",
    student_group_long = "Student Group",
    atsi_total = "ATSI Support Count"
  ) |>
  theme_vanilla()
```
